operation_details.item: The user's Q4 budget model covers the marketing department.

conversation.message: The Q4 budget model I am building covers the marketing department.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: We can structure the review around the model's assumptions, cost categories, and upcoming discussion points.

conversation.message: The model includes headcount and opex lines.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you a useful basis for comparing staffing-related costs with operating expenses.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I built the model in Excel.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For an Excel review, checking formulas, linked assumptions, and summary outputs could help you prepare.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The review with the FP&A director is next week.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: A concise walkthrough of the major drivers and key sensitivities should make that review easier to navigate.

conversation.message: I want to focus the discussion on the assumptions that could change the quarterly outlook.
